name: Melissa Woodward
original_name: メリッサ・ウッドワード
source:
Melissa Woodward is a young girl staying in Room 219 (Bravery) at Hotel Dusk with her father Kevin Woodward. She likes playing with dolls and Christmas. 

[Spoiler]She is also the half-niece of [url=/c149566]Iris[/url], although neither of them know this.[/spoiler]

[Based on the [url=https://cing.fandom.com/wiki/Melissa_Woodward]wiki[/url]]
